fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Miami municipal governance, including a petition to call an election for a charter board and discussion of one-way streets. Substantial coverage of Miami Beach civic affairs and elections, including debate over the purchase of Flamingo Park from the Carl G. Fisher interests and warnings to voters about provisions in a proposed gas franchise ordinance. The issue also features seasonal tourism-themed satire and sketches about winter visitors, local society items and letters to the editor, and sports and entertainment listings and advertisements, including greyhound racing and boxing coverage and movie/theatre notices.
